title: Marina's Beloved Corvette
subtitle: 1986 C4 Corvette Custom Styling & Treatment Study
summary: A multi-treatment styling exploration centered around a 1986 C4 Corvette, pairing the Sakura Vette custom livery with multi-angle treatment compositions featuring Mina.
narrative: A personal design study bringing together distinct visual directions for the 1986 C4 Corvette platform.
The primary hero view highlights the custom Sakura Vette graphic edition, while the secondary composition explores multiple body treatments, stance angles, and character styling with Mina.

gallery.caption: Marina's Beloved Corvette — Sakura Vette edition primary showcase.
Marina's Beloved Corvette — Multi-treatment composite study with Mina.

title: The Necromancer Series
subtitle: Cyber-JDM Street Brawlers & Character Portrait
summary: A narrative styling study featuring the Necromancer Z as the hero build alongside the Necromancer Skyline and realistic character portrait.

specifications.vehicles: Datsun/Nissan Z & Skyline R32/R34 Concept Platforms

narrative: The Necromancer series explores dark, aggressive cyber-JDM styling across classic Nissan/Datsun platforms.
Anchored by the high-output Necromancer Z, the study expands to include the character's widebody Skyline and a photorealistic depiction of the driver behind the machine.

gallery.caption: The Necromancer Z — Hero street build stance.
The Necromancer Skyline — Widebody build render with photoreal character portrait.

title: 1960 Chrysler Saratoga
subtitle: Swamp Bronze Paint & Stance Color Study
summary: A focused paint and color match study evaluating deep, metallic Swamp Bronze paint formulation against the long-roof body lines of a 1960 Chrysler Saratoga.
narrative: Created as an explicit paint formulation study to evaluate and match the rich, multi-stage reflections of metallic Swamp Bronze.
The sweeping fins and broad flanks of the 1960 Chrysler Saratoga serve as the canvas for assessing color depth under varying ambient lighting conditions.

gallery.caption: 1960 Chrysler Saratoga — Swamp Bronze paint depth and reflection study.

title: Night Wraith: '65 Cadillac Convertible
subtitle: Slammed Air Ride & Comfort Cruiser
summary: A 1965 Cadillac Convertible custom cruiser engineered with a custom bagged air suspension setup to lay frame while effortlessly clearing speed bumps, featuring additional short rear-hinged suicide doors on each side.

specifications.suspension: Custom Full-Range Air Ride (Lays frame & negotiates speed bumps)
specifications.doors: Re-Engineered Custom Short Rear Suicide Doors

narrative: Night Wraith captures the essence of classic South Bay boulevard cruising in a 1965 Cadillac Convertible silhouette.
Built strictly for comfort, presence, and smooth street performance, the body features re-engineered short suicide doors added behind the front doors on each side for refined passenger ingress.

The custom air ride chassis is engineered for full travel flexibility—allowing the massive land yacht to lay complete frame at park while lifting on command to clear steep driveways and speed bumps with ease.

gallery.caption: Night Wraith — Primary stance profile showcasing slammed frame geometry and custom body lines.
Night Wraith — Full ride height and air-bag travel comparison study.

title: 1962 Fiat 600 Halftone
subtitle: Supercharged Hayabusa Power & Ligurian Coast Study
summary: A 1962 Fiat 600 chopped 1", powered by a 1,507cc supercharged Hayabusa engine delivering ~300 WHP through a 6-speed sequential transaxle, featuring flag-colored halftone dot livery on a fantasy Ligurian coast.
thumb: Fantasies/62 Fiat 600 halftone flag colors on a fantasy Ligurian coast.jpg
heroImage: Fantasies/62 Fiat 600 halftone flag colors on a fantasy Ligurian coast.jpg
thumbnail: Fantasies/62 Fiat 600 halftone flag colors on a fantasy Ligurian coast.jpg
narrative: 1962 Fiat 600, chopped 1", powered by a 1,507cc supercharged Hayabusa engine delivering ~300 WHP through a 6-speed sequential transaxle, is supported by Short/Long Arm (SLA) double-wishbone suspension for optimal handling and 1.35g of lateral acceleration.
Finished in a striking tricolor halftone flag dot livery cascading along a winding fantasy Ligurian coastal road.
Related Design Study: See also Il Lungo: Stretched Fiat Paint Experiment for an extended silhouette and experimental candy finish companion study.

gallery.url: Fantasies/62 Fiat 600 halftone flag colors on a fantasy Ligurian coast.jpg
gallery.caption: 1962 Fiat 600 — Halftone flag colors on a fantasy Ligurian coast.
1962 Fiat 600 — Cornering profile study.
1962 Fiat 600 — Halftone livery dot pattern detail view.

title: 1965 Plymouth Valiant Mid-Engine
subtitle: Bob's Big Boy Friday Night Concept
summary: A mid-engine 1965 Plymouth Valiant concept realistically imagined during a Friday night cruise at Bob's Big Boy, combining classic compact Mopar lines with a transverse mid-ship powertrain layout.
narrative: Conceived right where real bench-racing happens—over a burger and fries at Bob's Big Boy on a Friday night.

This study takes the humble utility lines of a 1965 Plymouth Valiant and re-engineers the chassis around a balanced mid-engine layout, turning an understated economy sedan into an aggressive street brawler.

gallery.caption: 1965 Plymouth Valiant Mid-Engine — Bob's Big Boy Friday night stance study.

title: 1963 Lincoln Continental Halftone
subtitle: Guggenheim Halftone Livery Study
summary: A 1963 Lincoln Continental styling study exploring optical dot-matrix halftone livery parked outside the Frank Lloyd Wright-designed Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum.
narrative: An artistic exploration pairing the massive slab-sided geometry of a 1963 Lincoln Continental with precision halftone dot graphics.
Captured framing the sweeping modernist spiral architecture of the Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum in New York City, bridging classic luxury design with graphic optical texture.

gallery.caption: 1963 Lincoln Continental — Halftone livery study at the Guggenheim Museum.

title: Il Lungo: Stretched Fiat Paint Experiment
subtitle: Extended Silhouette & Experimental Finish Study
summary: A creative styling exploration extending a classic Fiat body shell into a sleek proportion while experimenting with depth-rich paint and clearcoat techniques.
narrative: Il Lungo (The Long One) plays with proportion and light refraction, stretching the European compact silhouette into an elongated street cruiser.
The primary focus of this study is testing rich, multi-layer candy depth and custom clearcoat formulations against dramatic body curves.
Related Design Study: For a compact, high-output sibling study utilizing similar Italian proportions, see the 1962 Fiat 600 Hayabusa Halftone.

gallery.caption: Il Lungo — Stretched profile and candy paint evaluation study.

title: 1959 Dodge Custom Royal Lancer GT
subtitle: Urban Adversarial Dazzle Scheme
summary: Parked in front of The Broad Museum on Grand Avenue in downtown Los Angeles, this 1959 Dodge Royal Lancer GT combines forward-facing sweep styling with an urban adversarial dazzle camouflage pattern.
thumb: Fantasies/1959 Dodge Custom Royal Lancer in an urban adversarial dazzle scheme.jpg
heroImage: Fantasies/1959 Dodge Custom Royal Lancer in an urban adversarial dazzle scheme.jpg
thumbnail: Fantasies/1959 Dodge Custom Royal Lancer in an urban adversarial dazzle scheme.jpg

specifications.engine: BMW M57 3.0L inline-6 diesel, compound twin-turbocharger system, single 10mm/12mm Stroker CP3 pump, 100%+ oversized injectors
specifications.chassis: Custom chassis, hidden 6-point DOM roll cage linked to suspension points, custom SLA front wishbones, EPAS rack-and-pinion steering, aftermarket Ford 9" IRS
specifications.wheels: 20" wheels with Michelin Pilot Sport 4S tires (275/35R20 front, 315/35R20 rear), tubbed rear wheel arches
specifications.performance: 700 hp, 1,000–1,050 lb-ft torque, ~4,300 lbs curb weight, 0-60 mph in ~3.2 seconds, 1/4-mile in ~10.9 seconds @ 128 mph, ~1.03g skidpad grip

narrative: Vehicle: 1959 Dodge Royal Lancer GT, 217 in in length, 122 in in wheelbase, custom chassis, hidden 6-point DOM roll cage linked to suspension points, custom SLA front wishbones, EPAS rack-and-pinion steering, aftermarket Ford 9" IRS, 20" wheels, Michelin Pilot Sport 4S tires (275/35R20 front, 315/35R20 rear), tubbed rear wheel arches, urban adversarial dazzle scheme.
Powertrain: BMW M57 3.0L inline-6 diesel, compound twin-turbocharger system, single 10mm/12mm Stroker CP3 pump, 100%+ oversized injectors, ZF 8-speed automatic transmission.
Performance: 700 hp, 1,000-1,050 lb-ft torque, ~4,300 lbs curb weight, 0-60 mph in ~3.2 seconds, 1/4-mile in ~10.9 seconds @ 128 mph, ~1.03g skidpad grip.

Setting: Parked on Grand Avenue in downtown Los Angeles, the car sits directly in front of The Broad Museum. The shot captures the building's complete honeycomb facade from ground level to roofline, including the entrance glazing and central oculus window. Adjacent downtown architecture and the curved steel structure of the Walt Disney Concert Hall frame the background.

title: 1964 Chevrolet Nova
subtitle: Urban Adversarial Dazzle Scheme

title: Mack F-Series Ramp Truck
subtitle: Square Cab Heavy Transporter & Dazzle Scheme
summary: A heavy-duty square cab Mack F ramp truck styled in an adversarial dazzle scheme, built for severe-duty vehicle transport.
narrative: Featuring the iconic heavy-duty square cab architecture of the Mack F-series.
Configured as a specialized ramp transport truck finished in a disruptive dazzle camouflage scheme.

gallery.caption: Mack F-Series Ramp Truck — Square cab transport configuration.

title: 1931 Ford Model AA Display Carrier
subtitle: Vintage Heavy Hauler & Cage-Car Transport Rig
summary: A vintage 1931 Ford Model AA truck re-engineered as an open-chassis display carrier, built to haul and exhibit open-cage race cars and custom chassis builds.
narrative: Inspired by conversations with custom shop builder Omar regarding dedicated display rigs for open-cage tube-frame cars.

This study pairs a heavy-duty 1931 Ford Model AA commercial cab and chassis with custom ramp geometry, transforming a classic pre-war workhorse into an eye-catching platform designed to showcase raw space-frame craftsmanship at events and shop displays.

gallery.caption: 1931 Ford Model AA Display Carrier — Primary ramp profile study.

gallery.url: Fantasies/31 AA Display carrier at NMP.jpg
gallery.caption: 1931 Ford Model AA Display Carrier — On-site exhibition render.

title: Sakura Soda Pop: Mk1 Capri
subtitle: 700+ WHP EA888 2.0L Compound-Turbo AWD Beast
summary: Because 2.0L is a drink size, not an engine! A Mk1 Ford Capri engineered around a boosted VW/Audi EA888 2.0L with compound turbos, DSG transmission, and 4MOTION AWD.

specifications.engine: 2.0L VW/Audi EA888 Inline-4 w/ Staged Compound Turbos (700+ WHP)
specifications.drivetrain: 4MOTION All-Wheel Drive w/ Widened MQB Suspension

narrative: Soda Pop plays on the classic gearhead jab that '2.0L is a drink size, not an engine!' by dropping a high-boost 2.0L EA888 engine into a featherweight Mk1 Ford Capri.
Mated to a tuned DSG transmission and 4MOTION AWD drivetrain over widened MQB geometry, custom box flares house 295-width Hoosier R-compound tires on center-lock wheels.
Featured here blowing past a carbon-bodied supercar along Route 66 near Cadillac Ranch for the Mother Road Centennial (1926–2026) in both classic Aqua Marine and the custom Sakura blossom livery.

gallery.caption: Sakura Soda Pop — Cherry Blossom graphic edition at Cadillac Ranch.
Soda Pop — High-gloss Aqua Marine edition staging alongside Route 66.
Soda Pop — Full technical specification and Mother Road Centennial render.

title: Project Lynx: Mid-Engine AWD Concept
subtitle: Mid-Engine e-AWD & Active Aero Performance Study
summary: A mid-engine, all-wheel-drive sports car design fantasy combining classic wedge supercar proportions with active aerodynamics and e-AWD torque vectoring.
narrative: Project Lynx explores an aggressive mid-engine AWD platform configured for high-speed stability and extreme cornering dynamics.
Blending iconic 1970s Italian-American wedge styling with active aerodynamic vacuum blowers and e-AWD front electric motors, Lynx delivers pure high-concept vision.

gallery.caption: Project Lynx — Mid-engine wedge supercar concept.

title: 1954 Willys Aero AWD Concept
subtitle: All-Wheel Drive Compact Performance Study
summary: An all-wheel-drive performance conversion concept bringing modern traction and turbocharged muscle to the classic 1954 Willys Aero compact body.
narrative: The 1954 Willys Aero combined lightweight unibody efficiency with streamlined post-war design.
This fantasy conversion pairs the Aero shell with a modern high-output engine and advanced AWD transfer case, turning the innocent 1950s commuter into an all-weather sleeper missile.

gallery.caption: 1954 Willys Aero AWD Concept — All-wheel-drive compact performance study.

title: Mid-Engine 'Cuda Concept
subtitle: Transverse Mid-Ship Mopar Performance Study
summary: A radical mid-engine layout exploration taking the aggressive proportions of the Plymouth Barracuda and re-centering the V8 powerplant behind the driver.
narrative: Re-imagining the iconic E-Body muscle car architecture through the lens of supercar dynamics.
By placing the engine mid-ship, weight distribution achieves optimal rear bias while maintaining the wide-track, menacing nose profile of the legendary Barracuda.

gallery.caption: Mid-Engine 'Cuda Concept — Transverse mid-ship Mopar performance study.

title: 1951 Hudson Pacemaker Custom
subtitle: Step-Down Chassis Lowrider & Cruiser Concept
summary: A tailored design study celebrating Hudson's famous step-down floorpan architecture with lowered air stance and shaved custom trim.
narrative: Hudson's revolutionary Step-Down chassis dropped the passenger floorpan inside the frame rails, giving the 1951 Pacemaker a naturally low center of gravity and low roofline long before it was standard.
This fantasy study accentuates those swept lines with bagged air suspension, seamless bodywork, and custom lowrider styling.

gallery.caption: 1951 Hudson Pacemaker Custom — Step-down chassis air-ride stance.

subtitle: Blown Big-Block Inboard Speed Hull & 6x6 Hauler
summary: A vintage wooden Crackerbox racing runabout powered by a superblown big-block Chevy, paired with a custom multi-axle 6x6 transport hauler study.
narrative: A high-speed study blending classic wooden Crackerbox inboard racing hull architecture with brute-force supercharged big-block power.
Accompanied by a heavy-duty custom 6x6 transport hauler designed to move the vintage watercraft through rugged terrain.
